banks.title: Banks
banks.lead: Cards are created in your own bank. Artemis never holds your funds.

help.stripe: Stripe account with Issuing enabled (EU). Create a restricted key with Issuing write permissions. Enter an existing cardholder (ich_…) or your company address so Artemis can create one.
help.qonto: Read access, freezing and reconciliation: Qonto does not pass the card on to third parties and forbids lending it. OAuth token from the Qonto partner programme; the approver can view a Qonto card securely and complete the payment themselves.
help.revolut: Grow plan or higher, “Cards API” access enabled by support, and written approval from Revolut (Valid Permission) before any production use. Requires direct handover (Settings).

hints.webhookSecret: whsec_… (once the webhook is created, see below)

banks.encrypted: Credentials are tested, then encrypted (AES-256-GCM). They are never displayed again.
banks.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect this bank? Agents using it will no longer be able to get a card.
banks.upgrade: Connecting a real bank is included from the Builder plan ({price}/month).
